$comment: CL1 reel length (D350): the longest and shortest a reel of each type may be. A reel (montage, match reel, impact-play reel) that would be longer is split at piece boundaries into parts 'part N of M', each at most the maximum; a single piece longer than the maximum is trimmed to the maximum around its peak and the trim is recorded. The user changes these in Settings > Clips (stored in settings.json clips.reelLengths); this file holds the defaults and the upper bound. Read by services/clip/reel_length.py and services/studio-ui/user-settings.mjs.
approved: user 2026-11-11: 'all montages and concatenated clips length cannot exceed 1 minute for now, if it gets more than 1 minute split it into after. add the settings to customise clip length for different type of reels in-app.'
limitNote: Upper bound of every maximum for now (user 2026-11-11). It may be raised later for long videos: change this one number.
